messages.subject: WICE Logistics | Regional supply chains, ESG and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Chudet Kongsoonthorn and WICE Leadership Team,

WICE's regional logistics platform and cross-border growth make the company a strong fit for my experience in industrial operations, stakeholder strategy and regulated supply chains.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover government and regulatory engagement, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy.

I work in a remote industrial environment where logistics continuity, contractor coordination and public-sector relationships directly affect business performance. I also bring energy-transition and carbon-governance experience, which strengthens my perspective on lower-carbon supply chains.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional responsibilities in Strategic Partnerships, Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations or country strategy. I have attached a WICE-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
